item.title: It’s been well worth the wait! @elysiabiro and I were invited ...
item.description: It’s been well worth the wait! @elysiabiro and I were invited to sing on @thetragicallyhip new cast album, “It’s a Good Life If You Don’t Weaken (Original Cast Recording)”, and it’s out today!You can stream our version of “Long Time Running” and order the vinyl or CD at linktr.ee/thehip (link in The Hip’s bio).We had the chance to work with Steve Berlin (producer of “Phantom Power”) and Bob Foster at 8A Studios to bring this new version to life. The album features the musical’s original cast, along with special guests @owenrieglingmusic and @allisonrussellmusicPretty special to be part of this one. Can’t wait for you all to hear it! #thetragicallyhip

item.description: clever arrives today as i sit in la however-it started as an idea when i was in londonand i feel grateful for how much i’ve grown as a person since thenand to be surrounded by such beautiful friends and family (including benji)and to be nourished by creativity (and by my fruit trees)i am grateful to loveeven if sometimes it doesn’t end the way you hopebecause you still had the chance to loveso thank you, clever
